PRIDE experiment type shotgun proteomics; MaxQuant MS/MS-triggered search. No explicit method statement.
MaxQuant Enzyme = Trypsin/P (summary.txt); Methods: 'Lys-C was added ... trypsin ... overnight'. PRIDE protocol text only says 'standard protocols'.
Fragmentation not stated.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl (fixed); Oxidation (M), Acetyl (Protein N-term), Acetyl (K) in acetyl-searched folders, SILAC label modifications (variable)
claims.evidence: parameters.txt Fixed modifications = Carbamidomethyl (C); summary.txt Variable modifications per folder; label states from Labels0/1/2. Acetyl (K) variable in every Ac folder and in 'MEF Cmpd-R PROT'; absent in the other PROT folders. Read with sdrf-tools search-params. Rows with fewer than 8 modification values are padded with the reserved word not applicable so every repeated column is filled (convert-openms rejects empty cells).

limitations: Review gate not run in this context: the producing task may not dispatch a fresh-context sdrf-adversarial-review subagent (no isolated context available); status REVIEW_FAILED (draft) per unattended-mode rule.
Paper Tables S1-S3 (per-experiment fractionation and replicate details) not retrieved; fraction identifiers are positional and fractionation method is only set when the file name names SCX or HpH.

Kasumi-1: Index/MaxQuant group all 44 files in one experiment (E1) but file names carry E2 tags and two date series (20160822/0829, 0901/0905): biological replicate written as 1, true replicate structure unverified.
Index experiment numbers do not equal the E-tags in file names for CBP112 (E1 holds files tagged E2) and Cmpd-R: the deposited MaxQuant experiment is followed.

8 RAW files (20171121 CBP112-1 acK SCX) are missing from Index_of_Raw_Data.xlsx; experiment taken from MEF CBP112 Ac summary.txt (E2), SILAC scheme assumed identical to the other CBP112 Ac experiments.
Acetyl-enriched and proteome samples of the same experiment number are kept as separate sources because the deposit does not state they share a lysate.
'control' arm is not defined further (vehicle/DMSO, wild type or no-4-OHT) for inhibitor and KO experiments; for p300 in vitro the control (H) arm is not defined (no p300 vs p300 + A-485).
Label modifications are listed as variable modifications as read by sdrf-tools search-params from summary.txt; they are applied to all channels of a run.

sdrf-tools reconcile reports two findings against pride.json: cleavage agent not named in the PRIDE text (paper Methods and MaxQuant parameters name Lys-C and trypsin) and instrument 'Q Exactive Plus' in the PRIDE text (RAW headers and paper say HF).

comment[precursor mass tolerance] omitted: deposited parameters.txt does not carry it (convert-openms then assumes 10 ppm; MaxQuant defaults are not asserted). The online-ontology run of parse_sdrf validate-sdrf stalled on OLS for >6 min and was killed; validation was run with --use_ols_cache_only.
Dose of A-485 in the time course and of Compound R in Kasumi-1 not stated in the retrieved text; omitted from treatment.
